tickSeconds.label: Look for summaries to send every (seconds)
tickSeconds.help: How often the shop looks for a daily summary or a month's fixed costs to send: yesterday's after the send time, a try that is due again, or a day the ERP asked for.

checkMinutes.label: Check the ERP's copy every (minutes)
checkMinutes.help: How often the open days are built again (a late cost or courier fact makes a new version) and compared with the copy the ERP keeps. A day the ERP lacks or holds in another version is sent again.

gapDays.label: Look back for days the ERP lacks (days)
gapDays.help: How many days back the shop asks the ERP which daily summaries it has, so a day it never got is sent by itself.

noCostLines.label: Costs this shop never has
noCostLines.help: Cost lines the shop never spends on (for example accessories). They are sent as 0. Every other cost line needs a figure each day, or the day is marked not complete yet: a missing figure is never sent as 0.

waitingCheckWarnDays.label: Flag returns waiting for the owner's check after (days)
waitingCheckWarnDays.help: Returned pieces still waiting for the owner's check in the ERP longer than this show under Needs you now on the Books page.

maxLineMinor.label: The most one cost may be (in paisa)
maxLineMinor.help: A fixed-cost line or one day's cost entry above this is refused as a typing slip (an extra zero). Set it far above your real costs.

maxMonthMinor.label: The most a month's fixed costs may be in all (in paisa)
maxMonthMinor.help: Salary, rent, utilities and other of one month together above this are refused as a typing slip. Set it far above your real costs.

listLimit.label: Cost entries listed at once
listLimit.help: How many cost entries Money → Costs shows at once, newest first. The page says when there are more.
